intent: Connect the finite canal district to the landscape through readable middle-distance layers, retaining a quiet open dusk setting.
baseline: SPACE10 houses, courts, gardens, roads, canal and navigation, reused without geometry changes.
changes: Broken woodland groups on the north-west and north-east slopes, with a low open area behind the central shops.
Grasses and reeds follow the actual western and eastern river bends; trees stand back from the water.
South-side meadow and a few trees at the two wings preserve the central reverse-view opening.
Outside-only meadow, wet-bank and root-contact material variation on the existing terrain, without overlay planes.
fixed: All SPACE10 buildings, routes and physical terrain
All lights, dusk HDR, fog, exposure and shadow frustum
The continuous river and bridge views
assets: Copy actual branch and foliage transforms from three established SPACE09 tree prototypes. Borrow the existing coverage-preserving leaf alpha texture and unit-card geometry.
responsiveReview: The same modest overview camera retreat applies to both comparison stages in a narrow panel; original wide-screen camera positions remain.
remainingIntentionalOpenings: View along the eastern water surface
notClaimed: A dense forest covering the full background terrain, new walkable outskirts or a fully photoreal environment.
